Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Tanay - 8 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Aditi - 9 years, daughter
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
3. Neeta - 39 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aditi stands in the courtyard. Tanay and Neeta stand near her.]

Tanay: "Aditi, what's the plan today?"

[Aditi draws a rangoli at the door.]

Aditi: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Tanay trips over a stone.]

Tanay (laughing): "What a day to remember!"
